forms.alt: 売,⿳士冖天-1935 ROC shortlived simp.,𧷓,𧷵,…

glyph_origin: Originally 𧷓, an ideogrammic compound (會意) and phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 出 (“go out”) + phonetic 買 (“buy”). 出, which indicates exoactive semantics (Sagart, 1999), was eventually reduced to the etymologically unrelated 士. Unrelated to 𧶠, which is used as a phonetic component in a number of characters.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 賣; s_page_origin explains the simplified 卖.
